timeline.text: Revealed at The Game Awards under the working title Project Century.
Named Stranger Than Heaven at Summer Game Fest 2025, with a new teaser.
Xbox Partner Preview: five eras from 1915 to 1965 across five cities, and platforms confirmed as PS5, Xbox Series and PC.
A dedicated half-hour Xbox broadcast covers the story, cast, combat and show business. Release window: this winter.
Summer Game Fest 2026: release date set for 15 January 2027, Tupac Shakur joins the cast, and pre-orders open.
Playable at Gamescom. SEGA publishes a 12-minute playthrough of the demo.
A 59-entry achievement list becomes public after achievement data for dozens of unreleased games proves readable through Steam.
Passes 1 million wishlists across platforms, the most for any RGG Studio game before launch.
SEGA names more characters and publishes a closer look at the show business system.
In an interview, the developers explain why the game is not sold as a Like a Dragon entry, and say its world is the same one.
RGG Studio releases the Act 1: Kokura story trailer.
A hands-on tour with a new demo begins in Japan.
Release on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Xbox Cloud Gaming and Steam, and on Game Pass from day one.

changelog.text: First version: achievement tracker for all 59 entries, act-by-act pages, release and edition details, cast, gameplay systems, timeline and a launch checklist.
